scenes.title_cn: 方法：两个技巧预判穿搭
scenes.title_en: The Method: Two Tricks to Predict Outfits
scenes.context: 抓到这条视频，你就告别出去玩买半天衣服、选半天衣服，结果到那里发现怎么穿都不合适的问题。两个技巧，包你可以提前预判你带的衣服到目的地怎么穿都合适。语域：穿搭教学，方法引入。
sentences: 抓到这条视频，你就告别买半天衣服选半天的问题。
Catch this video and say goodbye to hours of picking and choosing clothes.
hours of picking（买半天）
结果到那里发现怎么穿怎么搭都不合适。
Only to find that nothing you packed works at the destination.
nothing you packed（带的衣服）
两个技巧，包你带的所有衣服怎么穿都合适。
Two tricks guarantee every outfit you pack works anywhere.
works anywhere（怎么穿都合适）
paraphrase: 告别…问题 → say goodbye to the problem / ditch the hassle
怎么穿都合适 → works anywhere / fits every scene
scenes.speak: Catch this video and say goodbye to hours of picking and choosing clothes. Only to find that nothing you packed works at the destination. Two tricks guarantee every outfit you pack works anywhere.

scenes.title_cn: 技巧1：提取目的地主色调
scenes.context: 第一步打开手机搜索你要去的城市。注意不是让你搜这个城市穿什么，而是搜这个城市，把当地最有特点的图片全拿出来，用肉眼提取颜色。出现最多的主体就是建筑的颜色，建筑经常搭配门头、装饰的颜色。你选择衣服的主色调就有了。语域：穿搭教学，操作讲解。
sentences: 不是让你搜索这个城市穿什么。
Don't search for what to wear in that city.
what to wear（穿什么）
搜这个城市，把最有特点的图片都拿出来。
Search the city and pull up its most distinctive images.
distinctive images（有特点的图片）
用肉眼提取颜色，出现最多的就是建筑色。
Extract colors by eye — the most common one is the architecture.
extract colors（提取颜色）
paraphrase: 提取颜色 → extract the palette / pick out the colors
主色调 → main tone / dominant color
scenes.speak: Don't search for what to wear in that city. Search the city and pull up its most distinctive images. Extract colors by eye — the most common one is the architecture.

scenes.title_cn: 重点：色系融入当地环境
scenes.title_en: Key: Blend Into the Local Scene
scenes.context: 色系融入当地环境；主体配套了，其他都只是点缀。比如去法国，服装色系与当地建筑、门头呼应，随便拍都出片。语域：穿搭教学，原理讲解。
sentences: 色系融入当地环境，重点就对了。
Blend your palette into the local scene — that's the key.
blend into（融入）
主体配套了，其他都只是点缀。
Once the base matches, everything else is just accent.
just accent（只是点缀）
比如去法国，服装色系呼应当地建筑。
Say you go to France — echo the local architecture in your clothes.
echo the architecture（呼应建筑）
paraphrase: 融入环境 → blend into the scene / melt into the place
点缀 → accent / a finishing touch
scenes.speak: Blend your palette into the local scene — that's the key. Once the base matches, everything else is just accent. Say you go to France — echo the local architecture in your clothes.

scenes.title_cn: 技巧2：搜当地风格套自己的单品
scenes.title_en: Trick 2: Steal Local Styles, Use Your Own Pieces
scenes.context: 搜当地风格，比如留子风、法式千金风，套自己的单品。留子风元素：牛仔、吊带抹胸、骑士风上衣、大包、丝巾、墨镜。把有的单品全扔行李箱，随便穿随便搭都很配。语域：穿搭教学，操作收尾。
sentences: 搜当地风格，套自己的单品。
Search local styles and apply them to your own pieces.
your own pieces（自己的单品）
留子风元素：牛仔、吊带、丝巾、墨镜。
Study-abroad aesthetic: denim, camis, scarves, sunglasses.
study-abroad aesthetic（留子风）
把有的单品全扔行李箱，随便穿都配。
Throw all owned pieces into the suitcase — anything you wear matches.
anything matches（随便都配）
paraphrase: 套单品 → apply to your own pieces / work with what you own
apply pieces · work with what you own
随便都配 → anything matches / mix and match freely
scenes.speak: Search local styles and apply them to your own pieces. Study-abroad aesthetic: denim, camis, scarves, sunglasses. Throw all owned pieces into the suitcase — anything you wear matches.

practice: Two tricks guarantee every outfit you pack works anywhere.
Search the city and extract the architecture's dominant color.
Blend your palette into the local scene — that's the key.
Search local styles and apply them to your own pieces.
pitfalls: Search what to wear in France.
Don't search what to wear — search the city itself.
「不是搜穿什么」是 don't search what to wear。
Take out the photos of the city.
Pull up its most distinctive images.
「拿出有特点的图片」用 pull up distinctive images。
The color should be the same as the building.
Blend your palette into the local architecture.
Put all clothes into the box.
Throw all owned pieces into the suitcase.
shifts: 用 blend into（融入）、echo the architecture（呼应建筑）、anything matches（随便都配）
用 pull up distinctive images（提取特色图）、extract the palette（提取色系）、dominant color（主色）
用 study-abroad aesthetic（留子风）、accents（点缀）、mix and match（自由组合）
